scenes.teaser: Watch to the end: the 1-hour rule

items.text: In 5 years, nobody at work will remember the nights you stayed late.
Your kids will remember every single one.
You did it so they'd see you as reliable.
The late nights.
The 9 PM texts.
The "I'll handle it."
Brick by brick, you built a reputation.
Here's what nobody tells you:
When you leave, it stays in the building.
Your desk has a new name within weeks.
So what comes home with you?
Whatever's left.
The short temper. The silence.
The guy who's "just tired."
You can't always quit.
But you can stop giving the job what it never paid for.
The 1-hour rule:
Phone in another room for your first hour home.
That hour belongs to them.
Comment HELP if work is stealing it.
